questions.question: It was the lack of funding that had been causing problems for the project, rather than the team's inability to work together.
options: The project's failure was due to a combination of both factors.
It was the team's inability to work together that had caused most of the problems.
Lack of funding had been the main reason for the project's difficulties.
The team's skills and experience were not being utilized effectively.
questions.answer: Lack of funding had been the main reason for the project's difficulties.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already finished the report, but there was still a lot of work to be done on the presentation.
options: The team had completed both tasks before my arrival.
